description: Desktop-only permissions for the main window: none now. The updater has no permission here: the page reaches it only through the core's `check_update` and `install_update`, since the plugin's own `check` takes a proxy from whoever calls it. Nor has the restart: `install_update` restarts the program itself, since a page that could restart it could start every question paced for the session afresh (the review of 46418d0). The file is kept, desktop-only, so that a permission one of those plugins needs goes here and not into `default`: the Android build compiles neither plugin, and Tauri's build script resolves every permission identifier against the plugins actually compiled — one naming a plugin that was not is an error, which is how the Android job once went red on a change that had nothing to do with Android.
